request_mail.subject: Pickup: :contents for :recipient
request_mail.body:
Hello,

please pick up at our yard: :contents, :size.

Deliver to: :recipient, :district
Needed by: :due

Otherwise the technician stands in front of a hole in the wall and looks at it. He is good at that, but it does not fix anything.

Please confirm the route with a short mail.

Regards,
:contact
:sender

vehicle.met: And the right vehicle. Accounting nods.
vehicle.missed: You sent the truck for one parcel. The parcel had plenty of room. Accounting has less patience.

punctuality.met: At :recipient in time. The technician could get to work.
punctuality.missed: Late at :recipient. The technician stood at the customer without the part. We will hear about this.

feedback_mail.subject: Re: :contents for :recipient
feedback_mail.outro:
Every shipment arrives somewhere. Ideally on time.

Tammy

reminder_mail.subject: :contents for :recipient?
reminder_mail.body:
Hey,

the shipment for :recipient is still not on any route. Plan the route, confirm to the sender. The usual.

Tammy

complaint_mail.subject: Complaint: :contents
complaint_mail.body:
Hello,

our technician stood at a customer today without the :contents. The part was due with us by :due. It was not with us.

We now have a second appointment and a customer who no longer waves at our van.

Annoyed regards,
:recipient

request_mail.subject: Pickup: :contents for :recipient
request_mail.body:
Hello,

please pick up at our place: :contents, :size.

Deliver to: :recipient, :district
Needed by: :due

The shelf over there is empty. An empty shelf sells nothing. We did the math.

Please confirm the route with a short mail.

Regards,
:contact
:sender

vehicle.met: And the right vehicle. Accounting nods.
vehicle.missed: Wrong vehicle for the load. The diesel cost more than the goods.

punctuality.met: At :recipient in time. The shelf is full again.
punctuality.missed: Late at :recipient. Customers looked at an empty shelf and left.

feedback_mail.subject: Re: :contents for :recipient
feedback_mail.outro:
Every shipment arrives somewhere. Ideally on time.

Tammy

reminder_mail.subject: :contents for :recipient?
reminder_mail.body:
Hey,

the delivery for :recipient is still not on any route. Plan the route, confirm to the sender. The usual.

Tammy

complaint_mail.subject: Complaint: :contents
complaint_mail.body:
Hello,

the :contents were due with us by :due. Until then we had an empty shelf. A customer asked if it was art.

We would appreciate punctuality. And a shelf sign that says "Coming soon".

Regards,
:recipient

request_mail.subject: URGENT: :contents for :recipient
request_mail.body:
Hello,

urgent pickup: :contents, :size.

Recipient: :recipient, :district
Due by: :due

This is not a normal job. The goods are needed first thing tomorrow, not at some point tomorrow.

Please confirm the route by mail.

Kind regards,
:contact
:sender

vehicle.met: And the right vehicle. Accounting nods.
vehicle.missed: Wrong vehicle. On express jobs we pay the diesel and the customer pays the surcharge. One of those was avoidable.

punctuality.met: There before the shop opened. That is what :recipient pays the surcharge for.
punctuality.missed: Late. An express job that arrives late is a normal job with a surcharge. :recipient will do that maths for us.

feedback_mail.subject: Re: URGENT: :contents
feedback_mail.intro:
Hey,

about the express job :contents for :recipient.
feedback_mail.outro:
Express jobs belong on the morning route. Always.

Tammy

reminder_mail.subject: Express job :contents is waiting
reminder_mail.body:
Hey,

the express job for :recipient is not on a route yet. With "urgent" that stands out.

Tammy

complaint_mail.subject: Complaint: :contents arrived late
complaint_mail.body:
Hello,

we paid an express surcharge and still got the goods late. The deadline was :due.

We are happy to pay for speed. We are less happy to pay for excitement.

Kind regards,
:recipient

request_mail.subject: Return pickup: :contents
request_mail.body:
Hello,

please collect from us: :contents, :size.

Back to the sender: :recipient, :district
Due by: :due

The goods are in the way and turn a little more into furniture every day.

Please confirm the route by mail.

Kind regards,
:contact
:sender

vehicle.met: And the right vehicle for the return load.
vehicle.missed: Wrong vehicle for the return load. The driver restacked it twice and said something once.

punctuality.met: Back at :recipient in time. The credit note is on its way.
punctuality.missed: Back at :recipient too late. No goods, no credit note, and that credit note was already in somebody's books.

feedback_mail.subject: Re: return :contents
feedback_mail.intro:
Hey,

about the return of :contents to :recipient.
feedback_mail.outro:
Returns bring no money, but they prevent trouble. Also a currency.

Tammy

reminder_mail.subject: Return :contents still open
reminder_mail.body:
Hey,

the return for :recipient is not on a route yet. The goods are still in the aisle.

Tammy

complaint_mail.subject: Complaint: return of :contents
complaint_mail.body:
Hello,

the return was due by :due. The goods are still here, now with dust.

We would like the space back. And the credit note.

Kind regards,
:recipient

request_mail.subject: Fragile: :contents for :recipient
request_mail.body:
Hello,

please collect: :contents, :size. Fragile, please load accordingly.

Recipient: :recipient, :district
Due by: :due

The last shipment of this kind arrived as a jigsaw. We would rather not repeat that.

Please confirm the route by mail.

Kind regards,
:contact
:sender

vehicle.met: And the right vehicle, neatly loaded.
vehicle.missed: Wrong vehicle for fragile goods. The driver thought of you at every bump in the road.

punctuality.met: On time and in one piece at :recipient.
punctuality.missed: Late at :recipient. The goods sat in the yard for a long while instead. Fragile goods dislike both.

feedback_mail.subject: Re: :contents for :recipient
feedback_mail.intro:
Hey,

about the fragile load :contents for :recipient.
feedback_mail.outro:
What arrives intact arrives properly.

Tammy

reminder_mail.subject: :contents not on a route yet
reminder_mail.body:
Hey,

the shipment :contents for :recipient is not on a route yet. Fragile goods do not get sturdier in the warehouse.

Tammy

complaint_mail.subject: Complaint: :contents
complaint_mail.body:
Hello,

the shipment was due here by :due. It was not.

We postponed the display, and so did the customers. The goods did not.

Kind regards,
:recipient
